system.description:
Will Amp

When you would become a Maelstrom, by spending 2 Focus, you instead become an Abyss. You gain the benefits of being a Maelstrom, you can inflict Tidal Draw on all creatures affected by a Water Release Ninjutsu you cast and each time you deal Chakra damage to a creature, you regain 1 Focus.

While an Abyss, you increase each instance of damage you take by +4.
system.summary: Maelstrom, plus Tidal Draw on every creature your Water Release Ninjutsu affect and 1 Focus per chakra damage dealt; take +4 from each instance of damage.

rules.text: Maelstrom's benefits; Tidal Draw on every creature your Water Release Ninjutsu affects; each time you deal chakra damage, regain 1 Focus. Each instance of damage you take +4.
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Abyss)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +1d10 damage (2d10 at 7th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 15th, 5d10 at 19th; half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
